WHEN TO USE THE ENDING FRAME
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

OFF — ordinary continuation

H3 starts from the opening frame and invents a natural ending. This is the fastest way to extend a sequence.

ON — planned transition or drift reset

H3 must travel continuously from the opening frame to the supplied ending frame. Use a compatible composition: the same subjects, props and location, with a physically plausible path between them.

Do not use two unrelated pictures merely because both are attractive.

nodes.title: PROMPTING RULE OF THUMB
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Describe movement, not a new picture

Say who does what, in which order, what the camera does and any exact dialogue. If an ending frame is on, describe the plausible physical path that reaches it. Keep a 5-second shot to one main action; save a second action for the next run.

The local 8B Qwen model writes the H3 format and releases itself before H3 loads.

nodes.title: HANDOFF FRAME — visible recovery copy; AUTO CHAIN also retains it
NEXT SHOT
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Manual or automatic continuation

AUTO CHAIN off: each run uses the manual opening image. AUTO CHAIN on: the first run falls back to the manual image when the slot is empty, then every later queued run uses the preceding run's handoff automatically. You may queue several runs in advance; they execute sequentially.

The MP4 may receive RTX delivery finishing, but the HANDOFF always comes from native H3 frames. This prevents artificial texture accumulating across repeated shots. If drift appears, stop the queue, turn AUTO CHAIN off, load a clean Krea keyframe and run once.

","buttonColor":"#2E7D32","lineColor":"#2E7D32","width":1180,"height":260,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}

nodes.title: BENCHMARK RECORDER — atomic local JSONL after stable handoff
BENCHMARK STATUS — confirms recorded, cached, or duplicate
START HERE — FIVE-STEP LOOP + LOCAL EVIDENCE
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

ONE SHORT SHOT PER RUN — repeat it to build a longer sequence

  1. Load a manual opening image. Leave AUTO CHAIN off to use it directly, or turn AUTO CHAIN on beside the handoff controls.
  2. Type or dictate the action, camera and dialogue in Video Prompt Pixaroma. The 5-second setting is the safest starting point.
  3. Leave USE ENDING FRAME off for an open continuation. Turn it on only when the shot must land on a planned keyframe.
  4. Choose delivery quality: BALANCED RTX 1.5× is the measured everyday default; NATIVE is exact and fastest.
  5. Run. With AUTO CHAIN on, every later queued run reads the final frame saved by the run immediately before it — no manual reloading.

Reset or change projects: turn AUTO CHAIN off, load the new manual opening frame and run once. Give separate films different slot names. Automatic chaining is convenient but can compound drift, so retain and review the separate MP4 and HANDOFF files.

Benchmark lab: the benchmark start is wired into the real sampler seed path. After the decoded handoff is safely written, the recorder appends one local, deduplicated JSONL record. Keep project, model, profile and delivery settings aligned with the visible graph before comparing runs.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":4260,"height":260,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}
